more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Hydroxypropyl cellulose is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include table-top sweeteners in liquid form, table-top sweeteners in powder form, table-top sweeteners in tablets. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
Assessed food uses raised no concern.
High-dose animal studies found no reproductive or developmental harm.
